data.name: Haresh
data.gender_notes: Haresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haresh is a name of the Hindu god, Surya, who represents the sun and its power. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hari' meaning 'shining, radiant' and 'rishabh' meaning 'strong, powerful'. The name Haresh carries the meaning “God of Sun, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Haresh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of sun, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Haresh is a powerful name representing the divine energy of the sun and its ability to bring light and warmth into one's life.
data.etymology: Haresh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Sun, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haresh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Haresh is a name that is rich in Indian culture and history. It is associated with the revered Hindu deity, Surya, who is the god of the sun. The name Haresh evokes images of the powerful and radiant sun, which is often depicted as a symbol of vitality, energy, and longevity in Hindu religion and mythology. The name is also reflective of the divine power and honor bestowed upon individuals with this name, positioning them as carriers of a deep cultural heritage and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Haresh holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of the Sun God, Surya. Surya is considered to be the source of all life and energy, and is revered for his ability to provide light, warmth, and health to the world. By adopting this name, individuals may be attracted to the qualities of Surya and strive to embody his qualities of strength, power, and radiance in their own lives. The name Haresh can serve as a daily reminder of the divine light and energy within each of us and inspire us to live a life filled with vitality, purpose, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Haresh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harish', meaning 'bringer of joy or happiness'. It is believed that the deity Lord Hari, an aspect of Vishnu, is the source of this name. Haresh is thus a reminder to seek joy and happiness in the divine presence and to spread it to others.
